title: Magnetic Field B
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the magnetic field B must be correctly derived as B = (mu_0 * i) / (2 * pi * r) e_theta.

title: Electric Field E
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electric field E must be correctly derived as E = (V / (r * ln(R_2 / R_1))) e_r.

title: Magnetic Energy Density
description: Important Criteria: The magnetic energy per unit length must be correctly calculated as dW_m/dz = (mu_0 * i^2) / (4 * pi) ln(R_2 / R_1).

title: Electric Energy Density
description: Important Criteria: The electric energy per unit length must be correctly calculated as dW_e/dz = (pi * epsilon_0 * V^2) / ln(R_2 / R_1).

title: Inductance L
description: Essential Criteria: The inductance per unit length must be correctly derived as dL/dz = (mu_0 / (2 * pi)) ln(R_2 / R_1).

title: Capacitance C
description: Essential Criteria: The capacitance per unit length must be correctly derived as dC/dz = (2 * pi * epsilon_0) / ln(R_2 / R_1).

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the equations for electric and magnetic fields.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations, particularly for energy densities.
